GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out raced keenly & went Through to be 4 Lengths from the Leader . was in restricted room for a couple of strides on Straightening Up , got Clear , Battled On Well enough for 2nd # sound for 1st up
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: slow to begin. Raced fiercely in the early and middle stages of the  event. Raced in restricted room for a short distance at the entrance to the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to 5th bit keen 2 Lengths . Straightened Up out in Middle Of Track , couldn't quicken just whacked away # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward found front narrowly. Same to Straightening Up , Battled On Well before being swamped with 50m to go # led until late

dipped at start and Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths , Settled back 2nd last rails 6 Lengths 700m, started to work into the race before the corner but was Held Up for a stride, when run came last 200m he powered home but it was too late # looked bit stiff
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Knuckled on jumping away, shifted out. Approaching the 700m was tightened for room on the inside of another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Took A Sit 5th in between runners 4 Lengths . Straightened Up in Clear , Battled On Well enough for 3rd # had Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 900m was contacted by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok raced keenly Just Off Mid-Field in between runners 6 Lengths . Hooked Out Clear on Straightening Up now 4 Lengths from the Leader , Made Some Late Ground under hard riding # worked home fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after jumping away shifted out

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat 3 Wide With Cover Just off speed 1 Lengths 800m, Hard Ridden on the corner and weakened in Straight # wide/weakened
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: over raced in the early and middle stages. Raced wide without cover  throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , overraced rails behind speed 2 Lengths 800m, shuffled back behind tiring Leader before the corner and he was last Straightening Up , never really got going when had the chance in Straight but still prepared to forgive finishing position, blinkers again, winkers off first time # want to see again
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok then Drifted Back to tail 10 Lengths . Hard Ridden into Straight , did nothing # didn't fire a shot
Jumped Ok Settled 6th on rail 7 Lengths . Straightened Up 5 Lengths off, worked to line fairly but never looked a winning hope # Even Effort

Jumped Ok , scrubbed along 2nd last Two Wide 8 Lengths 600m, still well off them Straightening Up but rider angled him to Middle Of Track soon after, he wanted to get his head on side for the entire Straight but flew final stages and got up for exciting win # enormous win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the straight.
